title: Space Invaders Clone
description: A classic arcade game reimagined with modern web technologies. Control your spaceship and defend Earth from waves of alien invaders. Features smooth animations, responsive controls, and progressive difficulty levels.

title: Puzzle Master
description: An engaging puzzle game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Match colors, solve patterns, and progress through hundreds of increasingly complex levels. Built with WebGL for smooth animations.

title: Racing Thunder
description: High-speed racing game with stunning graphics and realistic physics. Choose from multiple vehicles, race on various tracks, and compete against AI opponents. Features include power-ups, time trials, and multiplayer mode.
